title: The batch gate files a known red case and reverts the landing that broke smoke
description: Run the real loop cycle against a real temporary Postgres control plane and a scratch bare Git remote: a catalog-only case red on the verified commit and the tip is filed known red, nothing is reverted and the tip verifies, with the probe saved in main-gate.json before the filing and a refused (409) filing not ending the run; a smoke case red only on the tip reverts its culprit, the recut verifies and the deploy watch serves it.

steps.name: Gate a known red case and a smoke regression through the real loop
